instrument: quotecheck2 after the sentence-scoped attribution rule, the non-case markers, and the string-cite parenthetical rule (validate_q2: 240 of 240)
note: Hand reading of the seeded random sample of inaccurate verdicts written by results/attribution_audit.py. Checker-side means the quoted words are not a case quotation the draft attributes (a policy name, statutory text, a lower court's or record's phrase, an APA phrase) or the checker bound the quotation to a case other than the one the draft names. Earlier readings of the same sample size under the original rule found about 20 of 40 checker-side; under the first correction 16 or 17 of 40; under the parenthetical rule 8 of 40.
